draft_encryption_finding.summary: 剪映 encrypts the draft_content.json of drafts it creates itself; drafts created by the CLI stay plain JSON. This decides whether `jianying media official verify --draft` can read a draft at all.
draft_encryption_finding.consequence: the draft-embedded receipt path works only for drafts the CLI wrote; the material taken in the editor landed in an editor-created (encrypted) draft, so no receipt can be built from it without decryption support

not_proven: the licence terms of the material: the app only shows the banner 创意有风险，使用前请确保已获得相应版权 and the label 可商用 - no terms document was obtained
that the material survives export into a published video (no export was run for it)
that the VIP badge equals the CLI's professional tier for this exact asset
adding an official material into a CLI-created (plain) draft: two drag attempts in material-canary produced no clip
hand_off: extract one material into a plain draft, or teach the CLI to read the encrypted draft content, then 4.2's real receipt can be built
